|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">レイアは、デス・スターの監房ブロックからガベージ・シュートへと、前代未聞の脱出を先導した。「かわいい香りとはおよそほど遠いぜ！」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Jump Into the Garbage Chute!

'''Card text:''' May not be used unless Trash Compactor is on table. Use when a battle is declared at another Death Star site. Move all of your characters at that site to Trash Compactor for free and cancel the battle.

'''Lore:''' Leia led an unprecedented escape from the Death Star detention block into a garbage chute. “That’s about as far from a sweet smell as you can get!”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese moves all of your characters at that site; the English moves all your characters involved.
